FAQ

Does it fit airline carry-on? Yes — at 55 × 33 × 23 cm it fits most airline sizers.

Is the rain cover included? Yes, it ships in the lid pocket.

The Trailhead pack is made for hikers who carry their own food and shelter for two or three nights. The hip belt and shoulder straps adjust in seconds, so the load rides on your hips instead of your shoulders. Side pockets hold a water bottle you can reach without stopping, and the front stretch pocket keeps a wet jacket away from dry gear. The lifetime warranty covers torn seams, broken buckles and failed zippers. To clean it, empty the pockets, hand-wash it in cool water with mild soap, and let it dry in the shade.
